row: DEBT-006 | ACTIVE-NEXT | Resident-training A/B/C evaluator not yet implemented
required_receipt_text: executable evaluator with A, B, C, Deleted definitions and per-row scores
why_it_mattered: Without fixed A/B/C/deleted arms, a pilot can become a toy success.

evidence.definitions_exist: scripts/ember_resident_training_gate.py emits a_b_c_deleted_contract naming all four arms (A = same task/evaluator/harness envelope with no native goal organ and no resident-training update; B = clean-room harness plus fixed hand-authored or prompt/rule policy with no learned update; C = same harness with model-learned RLM/iGRPO update; Deleted = C with the organ, recursive-query policy, verifier-conditioned update, or harness action channel removed), plus the pass_rule 'C beats A and B; Deleted degrades or blocks; budgets/evaluator/data/seeds matched; per-row scores present'.
evidence.executable_per_row_scoring_exists: The same script implements the scoring, not merely the definitions. It walks candidate.per_task_rows and, per row, requires task_id, source_row_idx, split == 'heldout', and then enforces the two arm inequalities directly: 'if row.get("c_score", 0) <= max(row.get("a_score", 0), row.get("b_score", 0))' emits candidate.per_task_rows.<idx>.c_not_gt_controls, and 'if row.get("deleted_score", row.get("c_score", 0)) >= row.get("c_score", 0)' emits candidate.per_task_rows.<idx>.deleted_not_degraded. The identical pair of inequalities is applied again over candidate.transfer_rows, yielding transfer_rows.<idx>.c_not_gt_b and transfer_rows.<idx>.deleted_not_degraded.
evidence.wired_into_the_gate_verdict: The evaluator is not dead code: the gate's component_status carries an a_b_c_deleted_evaluator entry computed as 'PASS' if candidate and candidate.get('matched_a_b_c_deleted') is True else 'BLOCKED', so a candidate that fails the per-row arm inequalities cannot report a passing evaluator component.
evidence.independence_from_drifted_receipts: This disposition is grounded in scripts/ember_resident_training_gate.py's bytes at master, deliberately NOT in the 2026-06/07 gate receipts. Those receipts pin artifact hashes that have since drifted from master (see the companion blocker re-verification receipt), so their component_status values describe a tree that no longer exists and were not used as evidence here.

successor: None required. DEBT-006's debt was that the A/B/C/Deleted evaluator was 'not yet implemented'. It is implemented, executable, and load-bearing on the gate's own verdict at master.
classification_law_basis: docs/ember-debt-ledger.md 'Classification Law' reserves ARCHIVAL/KILLED/EXCLUDED for rows disposed WITHOUT the work being done. This row is not one of those: the work the row demanded exists in-tree, so the row is DONE on its own terms rather than dispositioned around.
claim_boundary: This receipt claims only that the evaluator DEBT-006 demanded is implemented and executable at master. It makes NO claim that the evaluator has ever been run to a passing verdict on real arms, that the resident-training gate passes (it does not; the last real run is BLOCKED), or that any A/B/C result exists. DEBT-006's debt was implementation, not a passing run; the passing run is tracked by DEBT-001/DEBT-002 and the trigger-gated rows, which remain unresolved.
